name: Standard Role Catalog
description: Common roles for software delivery and consulting engagements

roles.name: Solution Architect
roles.description: Defines overall architecture direction, makes key technology decisions, ensures alignment with business goals
roles.whenNeeded: Always needed for any non-trivial project

roles.name: Technical Lead
roles.description: Leads the development team technically, ensures code quality and technical standards

roles.name: Backend Developer
roles.description: Implements server-side logic, APIs, data processing, and integrations
roles.whenNeeded: Core role for any project with server-side components

roles.name: Frontend Developer
roles.description: Implements user interfaces, client-side logic, and user experience
roles.whenNeeded: Needed for any project with a web or mobile UI

roles.name: DevOps / Platform Engineer
roles.description: Manages infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, and operational tooling
roles.whenNeeded: Needed for projects with cloud infrastructure or CI/CD requirements

roles.name: QA Engineer
roles.description: Designs and executes test strategy, builds test automation, ensures quality
roles.whenNeeded: Needed for projects requiring structured quality assurance

roles.name: Business Analyst
roles.description: Bridges business and technical teams, manages requirements, ensures alignment
roles.whenNeeded: Needed for projects with complex business domains or unclear requirements

roles.name: Project Manager / Delivery Manager
roles.description: Manages project delivery, timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication
roles.whenNeeded: Needed for projects with formal delivery governance

roles.name: Security Specialist
roles.description: Ensures security best practices, conducts security reviews, manages compliance
roles.whenNeeded: Needed for projects with security/compliance requirements

roles.name: Data Engineer
roles.description: Designs data pipelines, manages data infrastructure, ensures data quality
roles.whenNeeded: Needed for projects with significant data processing needs

roles.name: UX/UI Designer
roles.description: Designs user experience and interface for digital products

roles.name: Scrum Master / Agile Coach
roles.description: Facilitates agile ceremonies, removes impediments, coaches team on practices
roles.whenNeeded: Needed for teams following agile methodology
